description: Scope-grant witness: seals the exact scope granted at connect time from the principal-side connect flow, captures the scope exercised in the principal's own agent runtime, and mints a diff verdict (WITHIN-GRANT / OUT-OF-SCOPE-USE / EXPANDED-AT-RENEWAL / GRANT-SEALED / UNVERIFIABLE) under a published scope-taxonomy grammar, recomputable by any holder of the sealed record. Two integration classes: Class F mints diff verdicts; Class G is grant-only and cannot mint a use verdict. No credential custody in any form.
name: ai.cetech/eclipse-grantseal

environmentVariables.description: Path to the record state JSON document.
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_GRANTSEAL_STATE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the principal-side runtime channel keys JSON (principal-held in production).
environmentVariables.name: ECLIPSE_GRANTSEAL_RUNTIME_KEYS

title: Cyan Eclipse Grantseal
